answer: This bench does not ask who you are. It asks what you made, and when. The signal is the craft's fingerprint, the knoll is the purse's receipt, and the gale is the hall's own seal, pressed in wax. Faking 661 identities means 661 fresh proofs and 123 POA each, while the honest route costs one proof and 12 minutes. A farm falls at the first real check when the check is Master charcoal burner burn log with trade council attestation, which demands 6-year apprenticeship, 112 supervised kiln loads, masterpiece assessment, guild dues from every applicant.
